name: Meshech and Tubal

identification.note: Generally associated with peoples of Asia Minor; named alongside Magog in Ezekiel's prophecy against Gog.

description: Nations named among Japheth's descendants (Genesis 10:2), later listed as part of Gog's coalition in Ezekiel's prophecy against Magog (Ezekiel 38:2-3; 39:1).
